features.description: Unarmed die becomes 1d10.

features.name: Unshakable
features.description: Advantage on rolls against being frightened, restrained by mundane bonds, or moved against your will.

features.name: Combo Chain
features.description: When you hit the same creature with three unarmed strikes in one turn, it makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn. Once per turn.

features.name: Flurry(2)
features.description: Flurry: three unarmed strikes, or two strikes and a shove (Might or Precision contest).

features.name: Stone Body
features.description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Knockout Blow
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit with unarmed, force an Endurance roll vs Precision DC; on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn (or unconscious if HP are below 50).

features.name: Undisputed
features.description: Unarmed die 2d8. When you roll initiative, regain all Drive (Flurry uses). Combo Chain stuns on two hits against the same target in a turn.

features.name: Null Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with unarmed, the target has disadvantage on rolls to maintain ongoing spells until the start of your next turn, and you deal +1d4 force.

features.name: Spell Ward
features.description: Reaction: when targeted by a spell, add +1d6 to AC or to a roll against its DC. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Redirect
features.description: When you succeed on a roll against a single-target spell of 3rd rank or lower, you may use your reaction to redirect it to another creature within 30 feet of you (original caster's roll or your Precision for attack).

features.name: Silencing Blow
features.description: When you hit with Null Strike, the target cannot cast spells with verbal components until the end of its next turn (Endurance vs Precision DC).

features.name: Mana Rend
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit a creature concentrating on a spell (or maintaining an ongoing spell effect), it takes +3d8 force and the roll to keep the spell has disadvantage.

features.name: Spellbreaker
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your unarmed strikes end ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on the target on a hit (Judgment vs Precision DC for 6th+).

features.name: Weak Point
features.description: Bonus action: analyze a creature within 30 feet; until the end of your next turn your unarmed attacks against it ignore 2 AC from armor/shield and deal +1d4.

features.name: Armor Crack
features.description: When you hit the same creature twice in a turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn (stacks to -3).

features.name: Precise Blow
features.description: Once per turn add Precision modifier again as bonus damage against a Weak Point target (min +1).

features.name: Shatter Guard
features.description: Action: one melee unarmed attack with advantage; on hit destroy a nonmagical shield or reduce magical AC bonus by 1 for 1 minute. Once per short rest.

features.name: Vital Strike
features.description: When you crit with unarmed, deal +3d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Breaking Point
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Weak Point is permanent on one target, Armor Crack stacks to -5, and Precise Blow applies to every hit against it.

features.name: Flowing Element
features.description: Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or water/force). Unarmed strikes deal +1d4 of that type. Change on long rest.

features.name: Current Step
features.description: When you Flurry, you may move 10 feet before or between strikes without provoking.

features.name: Redirect Flow
features.description: Reaction: when hit by a melee attack, Speed contest vs attacker's Might or Precision; on success take half damage and the attacker takes the other half as your element type.

features.name: Elemental Palm
features.description: Action: 15-ft cone of your element, 4d6 damage (Speed vs Precision DC halves). Once per short rest.

features.name: Still Water
features.description: At the start of your turn, if you moved 0 feet since the start of your last turn, regain 1 Drive and gain +1 AC until you move.

features.name: Perfect Flow
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Flurry does not cost Drive, Flowing Element becomes +2d6, and Redirect Flow auto-succeeds once per turn.

features.name: Bounty
features.description: Bonus action: designate a creature within 60 feet as your Bounty for 1 hour (or until it drops to 0). Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One bounty. Bounty(2) improves.

scaling.change: Bounty(2): +proficiency to track; damage +1d6 more at 8 from scaling

features.name: Tracker
features.description: Advantage on Judgment and Precision checks to track, hunt, or recall lore about beasts and humanoids you have studied for 1 minute.

features.name: Spellcraft(2)
features.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Judgment.

features.name: Hunter's Discipline
features.description: Choose a discipline: Archery (+2 ranged attacks), Dual Wield (draw/stow freely; bonus attack with light weapon adds Precision), or Two-Handed (+2 damage with two-handed melee). Change on long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Land Stride
features.description: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Advantage on rolls against plants that impede movement magically.

features.name: Bounty(2)
features.description: Add proficiency bonus to tracking rolls related to your Bounty. You know the direction to your Bounty while it is on the same plane and within 1 mile.

features.name: Volley
features.description: Action: make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you choose within range (separate rolls; one attack each). Once per short rest.

features.name: Vanish into the Wild
features.description: You can Hide as a bonus action. In natural terrain, leaving no tracks and becoming invisible until you attack or cast while remaining still for 1 round (once per short rest).

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: Once per turn, treat a ranged weapon attack roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Against your Bounty, critical hits on 19-20.

features.name: Last Hunt
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute against your Bounty: attacks have advantage, Bounty damage becomes +4d6, and reducing it to 0 HP restores 4d10 HP to you.

features.name: Interrogate
features.description: Advantage on Confidence and Judgment checks to extract information. After 1 minute of questioning, know if the creature knowingly lied (Judgment contest).

features.name: Manacles
features.description: Bonus action: restrain a grappled or willing creature (escape DC = your Precision DC). While restrained this way, disadvantage on spell attacks and rolls against spell DCs.

features.name: Cutpurse's Bane
features.description: Against humanoids marked as Bounty, weapon attacks deal +1d6 and you have advantage on rolls to detect illusions and disguises.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.description: Your Bounty lasts 24 hours. You ignore the first exhaustion from forced marches when pursuing it.

features.name: Verdict
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit your Bounty, it makes a Judgment roll vs Precision DC or is incapacitated until the end of its next turn and takes +2d8 damage.

features.name: Hand of the Law
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute humanoid enemies within 30 feet cannot Hide from you, your Bounty damage applies to all humanoids, and Manacles can be applied as a reaction when you hit.

features.name: Monster Lore
features.description: After observing a creature for 1 round, learn its resistances, immunities, and one special action. Advantage on Bounty attacks against aberrations, monstrosities, and undead.

features.name: Warding Trap
features.description: Action: set a trap in a 5-ft space (1 minute to hide it). First enemy to enter takes 2d8 damage (type chosen) and Speed vs Precision DC or is restrained 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Silver Edge
features.description: Your weapon attacks against shapechangers and undead count as silvered and deal +1d6.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Reaction: when an enemy within 5 feet moves away, opportunity attack with advantage; on hit speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

features.name: Bane Strike
features.description: Once per turn against a studied monster type, +2d6 damage and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Monsterbane
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute choose a creature type; your attacks against that type crit on 18-20 and ignore resistance to weapon damage.

features.name: Beast Companion
features.description: Beast companion CR 1/4+. Commands as bonus action; shares your initiative. Bond ritual 8 hours if slain.

features.name: Feral Bond
features.description: While within 30 feet of your companion, you both add +1d4 to damage against your Bounty. You can transfer HP (action) up to your Ranger level between you once per short rest.

features.name: Pack Hunt
features.description: When you hit your Bounty, your companion may use its reaction to make one attack against it.

features.name: Primal Senses
features.description: You and your companion have blindsight 10 feet and advantage on Judgment checks to detect hidden creatures.

features.name: Shared Fury
features.description: When you use Volley or Extra Attack, your companion may Dash or Attack as part of your bonus action command without spending the bonus action (once per turn).

features.name: Wild Sovereign
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your companion grows one size, gains +2 AC and Extra Attack, and Pack Hunt triggers on every hit against your Bounty.

features.name: Soul Harvest
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, gain 1 Soul (max = proficiency bonus). Bonus action: spend 1 Soul to regain 1d8 + Confidence HP. Soul Harvest(2) improves spending options.

scaling.change: Soul Harvest(2): spend 1 Soul for +1d6 on a hit; or 2 Souls to regain 2d8+Confidence

features.name: Dark Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 necrotic. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

features.name: Spellcraft(2)
features.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Dread Aura
features.description: Aura 10 feet: enemies that start their turn there make a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or have disadvantage on their next attack before the start of your next turn. Soft once-per-creature-per-minute. Dread Aura(2) expands.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Soul Harvest(2)
features.description: Spend 1 Soul when you hit to deal +1d6 necrotic, or 2 Souls as a bonus action to regain 2d8 + Confidence HP.

features.name: Life Drain
features.description: When Dark Strike damages a creature, you regain HP equal to half the Dark Strike bonus dice (rounded up).

features.name: Reap
features.description: Action: melee attack against each creature within 5 feet. Separate rolls. Once per short rest.

features.name: Dread Aura(2)
features.description: Aura becomes 30 feet. Failed Judgment also deals 1d6 psychic.

features.name: Soul Furnace
features.description: At the start of combat, gain 2 Souls. Max Souls becomes proficiency bonus + 2.

features.name: Harbinger
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Dark Strike becomes +3d6, Dread Aura auto-applies disadvantage without a roll once per creature turn, and reducing a creature to 0 HP grants 2 Souls.

features.name: Veilwalk
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

features.name: Phase Shift
features.description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage and teleport 10 feet. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Between Worlds
features.description: You can see into the ethereal within 30 feet. Attacks against ethereal creatures within reach have no disadvantage from that state.

features.name: Shade Ambush
features.description: When you Veilwalk, your next attack before the end of the turn has advantage and qualifies for Dark Strike even if already used this turn (still once for the extra trigger).

features.name: Crossroads Gate
features.description: Action: create a linked pair of gates within 60 feet for 1 minute; any creature entering one exits the other. Once per short rest.

features.name: Lord of the Crossing
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Veilwalk has unlimited uses, range 60 feet, and Phase Shift does not expend uses.

features.name: Possessed Weapon
features.description: Your weapon houses a devil. It is magical. Bonus action: for 1 minute the devil aids you (+1d4 damage; you may reroll one damage die per hit). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Infernal Armor
features.description: While Possessed Weapon is active, +1 AC and resistance to fire. When hit by melee, the attacker takes 1d4 fire.

features.name: Augment
features.description: Spend 1 Soul as a free action when you hit to add 2d6 fire or necrotic (devil's choice when bound).

features.name: Twin Pact
features.description: Once per short rest, the devil acts independently: as a reaction it makes one weapon attack using your bonuses when a creature within 5 feet attacks you.

features.name: Overtaken
features.description: Bonus action: let the devil overtake you for 1 minute — advantage on Might and Confidence, +2d6 fire on melee, must attack if able each turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Perfect Vessel
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and the devil act in unison: Extra Attack grants one additional attack, Augment costs no Soul once per turn, and Infernal Armor reflects 2d6 fire.

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Corrupt Spell
features.description: When you cast a Reaver spell of 1st rank+, you may deal +1d6 necrotic to one target and become lightly corrupted until a short rest (Guide tracks corruption; at 3 stacks disadvantage on Judgment social rolls until long rest).

features.name: Blight Bolt
features.description: Cantrip: ranged spell attack 60 feet, 1d10 necrotic; scales Cantrip d10. On hit, target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Decay Aura
features.description: Aura 10 feet: enemies starting turn there take 1d4 necrotic. Scales Ongoing d4 every 5 from 9.

features.name: Rotting Word
features.description: Action: creature within 60 feet makes Endurance vs Confidence DC or takes 4d8 necrotic and is poisoned 1 minute. Once per short rest.

features.name: Unmaking
features.description: Once per long rest when you hit with a spell or Dark Strike, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Confidence DC; on a failure ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on it end, and it takes +4d8 necrotic.

features.name: Herald of Ruin
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Decay Aura becomes 30 feet and 2d6, Corrupt Spell +2d6, and Blight Bolt hits all creatures in a 10-ft radius of the primary target (one attack roll vs each).

features.name: Oath of Steel
features.description: You are proficient with heavy armor, shields, and martial weapons. As a bonus action, adopt a Guard: +1 AC until the start of your next turn, or +1d4 to one ally's AC within 5 feet until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Heavy Training
features.description: Ignore speed reduction from heavy armor. Climb and swim at full speed in heavy armor (still disadvantage on Stealth if armor imposes it).

features.name: Rally
features.description: Bonus action: you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to 1d8 + Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Rally(2) improves.

scaling.change: Rally(2): 2d8+Confidence; also end fear on affected allies

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Bulwark
features.description: While wielding a shield, +1 AC. Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack(2)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 2 extra attacks (three times total).

features.name: Rally(2)
features.description: Rally grants 2d8 + Confidence temporary HP and ends the frightened condition on affected allies.

features.name: Unyielding
features.description: When you fail an Endurance or Might roll, you may succeed instead. Once per short rest.

features.name: Paragon
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute gain +2 AC, Rally does not expend uses, and Bulwark reactions do not expend uses.

features.name: Glory Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d6 and you or an ally within 30 feet gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Challenge
features.description: Bonus action: challenge a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. It has disadvantage on attacks against others while within 5 feet of you; you have advantage on attacks against it. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Herald's Banner
features.description: Action: plant a banner (30-ft aura, 1 minute). Allies add +1 to attack rolls. Once per short rest.

features.name: Duelist's Honor
features.description: Against your Challenge target, critical hits on 19-20 and they cannot make opportunity attacks against creatures other than you.

features.name: Valor
features.description: When an ally within 30 feet hits your Challenge target, you may use your reaction to make one melee attack against it.

features.name: Legend
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Glory Strike becomes +2d6, Challenge has unlimited uses, and Herald's Banner is always active.

features.name: Shield Wall
features.description: While wielding a shield, allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC. You can shove as a bonus action.

features.name: Intercept
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 5 feet is hit, take the hit instead (damage applies to you). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Fortress
features.description: Action: until the start of your next turn, +2 AC and resistance to a damage type you choose when you activate. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Taunt
features.description: Bonus action: enemies within 15 feet make a Judgment roll vs Might DC or must target you with their next attack before the end of their next turn if able.

features.name: Iron Bastion
features.description: Intercept grants you resistance to the redirected damage. Shield Wall becomes +2 AC to allies within 5 feet.

features.name: Living Wall
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Intercept has unlimited range 30 feet, Fortress is permanent for the duration, and you have resistance to all damage.

features.name: Executioner
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature below half its HP maximum, deal +1d8. Against creatures at 0 HP you may choose to knock out instead of kill.

features.name: Cleave
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, make one melee attack against a different creature within reach as part of the same attack (once per turn).

features.name: Bloodied Fury
features.description: While you are below half HP, +2 to melee damage and advantage on Might rolls.

features.name: Headsman
features.description: Critical hits with melee weapons deal +2d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC or is frightened of you for 1 minute.

features.name: Reaping Blow
features.description: Action: one melee attack with advantage; on hit +4d8 and if the target has 50 HP or fewer after the hit it drops to 0. Once per short rest.

features.name: Kingslayer
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Executioner applies to all hits (+2d8), Cleave can chain a second time, and Reaping Blow threshold becomes 100 HP.

features.name: Reach Mastery
features.description: Spears, lances, and polearms you wield have +5 feet reach if they did not already have reach, or +5 feet additional if they did (max 15 feet). Opportunity attacks with these weapons do not require a reaction when a creature enters your reach (once per turn free; further cost reaction).

features.name: Spearwork
features.description: You may use Precision for attack and damage with spears, lances, and polearms. Once per turn when you hit with such a weapon, deal +1d4.

features.name: Leap
features.description: Bonus action: jump horizontally up to your speed (or vertically half) without a running start; opportunity attacks against you during the leap have disadvantage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Leap(2) improves.

scaling.change: Leap(2): land adjacent to a creature and make one spear attack with advantage

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Impale
features.description: When you hit with a reach weapon, you may force a Might roll vs Precision DC; on a failure the target is restrained by the weapon until you withdraw it (bonus action) or they succeed on the roll at end of turn. While impaled, you cannot attack other targets with that weapon. Once per short rest.

features.name: Whirlwind
features.description: Action: one melee attack with a reach weapon against each creature of your choice within reach. Once per short rest.

features.name: Leap(2)
features.description: When you Leap, you may land within 5 feet of a creature and make one spear/polearm attack with advantage as part of the bonus action.

features.name: Skewer
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature that is Large or smaller with a reach weapon, deal +2d8 and push it 10 feet; Speed vs Precision DC negates the push.

features.name: Favor of the Monkey King
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your spear strikes can target any creature you can see within 60 feet (the strike bridges the gap with golden reach). Attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

features.name: Dive Strike
features.description: When you Leap or fall at least 10 feet before an attack, the attack has advantage and deals +1d6.

features.name: Soaring Leap
features.description: Leap distance doubles. You take no falling damage from leaps of your own making.

features.name: Talon Grip
features.description: When you hit after a Leap, you may grapple the target (Precision contest vs Might or Precision). While grappled this way, you both remain aloft if you Leap again with them (they fall if released midair).

features.name: Sky Lance
features.description: Ranged thrown spear attack 30/90; returns to your hand after the attack. Deals Spearwork bonus.

features.name: Eagle's Eye
features.description: Advantage on Precision checks relying on sight. Once per turn ignore half cover with spear attacks.

features.name: Falling Star
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, Leap any distance within 120 feet and make Whirlwind on landing; each hit deals +2d8 and Dive Strike applies.

features.name: Coil
features.description: Bonus action: take a coiled stance until you move. Your next spear attack has advantage and deals +1d6; if it hits, you may move 10 feet without provoking.

features.name: Venom Fang
features.description: Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d4 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.

features.name: Quick Strike
features.description: Reaction: when a creature enters your reach, make one spear attack. Uses = Precision modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Serpent Sway
features.description: While coiled or after a Coil attack, +2 AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Twin Fang
features.description: When you hit with Coil's attack, make one additional spear attack against the same target as part of that bonus action.

features.name: Viper's Tears
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Venom Fang becomes 2d6 poison and a failed Endurance roll also incapacitates until the end of the target's next turn; Coil does not require staying still.

features.name: Web Line
features.description: Bonus action: create a 30-ft line of silk between two points or to a surface; it is difficult terrain for enemies and can be climbed by you without checks. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Snare
features.description: Action: creature within 30 feet makes a Speed roll vs Precision DC or is restrained by silk 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.

features.name: Eight Points
features.description: You ignore difficult terrain from webs/silk. Opportunity attacks with spears have advantage against restrained creatures.

features.name: Tangling Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit, the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn (Speed vs Precision DC negates).

features.name: Silk Step
features.description: You can walk on walls and ceilings while touching silk or Web Line. Bonus action teleport up to 20 feet along your silk.

features.name: Web of Lies
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, fill a 30-ft cube within 60 feet with silk for 1 minute: enemies treat it as difficult terrain, are lightly obscured to others, and at the start of their turns make Speed vs Precision DC or are restrained until they escape.

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Cantrips(2)
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Verse

Verse(2)/(3) improve.

features.name: Harmony
features.description: When you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+ that targets an ally, another ally within 15 feet of them gains half the healing or +1d4 on their next attack before your next turn.

features.name: Verse(2)
features.description: Verse die becomes 1d6. Gain one additional Verse use.

features.name: Countersong
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 60 feet fails a Judgment or Confidence roll against a charm/fear effect, add your Confidence modifier to the result. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Encore
features.description: When your Verse ends, you may immediately begin a different Verse without expending a use (once per short rest).

features.name: Verse(3)
features.description: Verse die becomes 1d8. When you start a Verse, allies in range gain temporary HP equal to your Confidence modifier (min 1).

features.name: Crescendo
features.description: Once per long rest when you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+, treat it as one slot rank higher and Verse die becomes 1d10 for 1 minute.

features.name: Magnum Opus
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute both Courage and Dissonance apply, Verse does not expend uses, and allies in range add your Confidence modifier to damage rolls.

features.name: Tulip's Bloom
features.description: When you restore HP with a Songsmith spell or feature, add 1d6. Once per turn grant the target +1 AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Warm Refrain
features.description: Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Confidence HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Rebirth Hymn
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

features.name: Spring Chorus
features.description: Verse of Courage also causes allies to regain 1d4 HP at the start of their turns.

features.name: Lifesong
features.description: Action: heal three creatures within 30 feet for 3d8 + Confidence. Once per short rest.

features.name: Eternal Spring
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet automatically succeed on death rolls and regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns.

features.name: War Hymn
features.description: Verse of Courage also adds +1d4 to allies' damage rolls.

features.name: Golden Rally
features.description: Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet gains advantage on their next attack and +1d6 damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Burning Chorus
features.description: When you deal damage with a Songsmith cantrip or spell, add +1d6 fire once per cast.

features.name: Sunfire Verse
features.description: Dissonance also deals 1d6 fire to an enemy the first time it hits an ally each turn.

features.name: Anthem
features.description: Action: allies within 30 feet gain +2 to attacks and damage for 1 minute. Once per long rest.

features.name: Marigold Blaze
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute War Hymn becomes +2d6 damage, Burning Chorus +2d6 fire, and Anthem is active.

features.name: Thorned Lullaby
features.description: Bonus action: a creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or is charmed until the end of your next turn (hostile acts end it). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Dirge
features.description: Verse of Dissonance: enemies also have disadvantage on Judgment rolls while in the aura.

features.name: Wilting Note
features.description: Cantrip-like action: one creature within 60 feet takes 2d6 necrotic (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves). Scales Cantrip d6-equivalent as Burst. Uses at will.

features.name: Requiem
features.description: When a creature charmed by you takes damage from your spells, it takes +1d8 psychic and the charm does not auto-end from that damage (still ends on other allies harming it).

features.name: Mourning Song
features.description: Action: enemies within 30 feet make Judgment vs Confidence DC or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat each turn). Once per short rest.

features.name: Black Rose Elegy
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Thorned Lullaby auto-succeeds once per turn (still costs bonus action), Wilting Note deals 4d6, and frightened enemies take 2d6 psychic at the start of their turns.

features.name: Spellcraft(3)
features.description: You cast using a short-rest slot table: few slots that return on a short or long rest. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Intellect.

features.name: Grace Bolt
features.description: Cantrip action: up to two creatures within 60 feet of you and within 10 feet of each other; ranged spell attack against each. On hit 1d8 radiant + 1d4 fire. Scales: extra target or die at Grace Bolt ranks. Cantrip d8 for the radiant die.

features.name: Radiant Invocations
features.description: Learn two Radiant Invocations (Seal lists add more). Invocations modify Grace Bolt or grant at-will lesser miracles. You learn more at Radiant Invocations(2).

scaling.change: Radiant Invocations(2): learn two more; one may be greater

features.name: Siphon Grace
features.description: When you hit with Grace Bolt, regain HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1) once per turn. Siphon Grace(2) improves.

scaling.change: Siphon Grace(2): also gain temporary HP equal to number of Grace Bolt targets hit

features.name: Grace Bolt(2)
features.description: Grace Bolt deals 2d8 radiant + 1d4 fire and can target up to three creatures (each within 10 feet of at least one other target).

features.name: Radiant Invocations(2)
features.description: Learn two additional Radiant Invocations.

features.name: Grace Bolt(3)
features.description: Grace Bolt deals 3d8 radiant + 1d4 fire (up to three targets).

features.name: Siphon Grace(2)
features.description: When Grace Bolt hits, gain temporary HP equal to the number of targets hit in addition to Siphon healing.

features.name: Haloed
features.description: You shed bright light 10 feet / dim 10 feet (suppressable). Advantage on Judgment rolls against fear and possession. Once per short rest as a bonus action, end one mild curse or poison on yourself.

features.name: Grace Bolt(4)
features.description: Grace Bolt deals 4d8 radiant + 1d4 fire and can target up to four creatures.

features.name: Borrowed Miracle
features.description: Once per short rest, cast a 1st- or 2nd-rank Wraith spell without expending a slot.

features.name: Unchained
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Grace Bolt targets up to six creatures within 60 feet (no clustering required), Siphon Grace heals Intellect + proficiency bonus, and you regain one short-rest slot at the start of each of your turns (max your slot total).

features.name: Enochian Binding
features.description: Learn the Nephilim Invocation list. Bonus action: bind a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Grace-Edged
features.description: Your melee weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant. You may use Intellect for attack and damage with simple melee weapons.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Seal Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a bound creature with a weapon or Grace Bolt, deal +2d6 radiant and pull it up to 10 feet toward you.

features.name: Script of Ruin
features.description: Action: a bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 radiant (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves) and is knocked prone on a failure. Once per short rest.

features.name: Nephil Ascendant
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you fight as if you had Extra Attack(2) (2 extra attacks, 3 total), Grace-Edged becomes +2d6, and Enochian Binding does not expend uses.

features.name: Burning Wings
features.description: Learn Seraphim Invocations. Bonus action: for 1 minute gain fly speed 30 feet (hover). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. While flying, Grace Bolt fire die becomes 1d6.

features.name: Holy Flame
features.description: When Grace Bolt hits, the target takes +1d6 fire at the start of its next turn unless it spends its action to extinguish (no roll).

features.name: Empowered Bolt
features.description: Once per turn, add Intellect modifier again as radiant damage to one Grace Bolt hit.

features.name: Seraph's Gaze
features.description: Action: creatures of your choice within a 30-ft cone make a Judgment roll vs Intellect DC or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Once per short rest.

features.name: Sixfold Fire
features.description: Grace Bolt may deal all fire or all radiant. When you hit three or more targets, deal +2d6 fire to each.

features.name: Throne Fire
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Burning Wings is permanent, Holy Flame becomes 2d6, and Grace Bolt gains a 15-ft radius burst option (Speed vs Intellect DC; half on success) dealing Grace Bolt damage once.

features.name: Virtue's Mend
features.description: Learn Virtue Invocations. Bonus action: touch a creature to restore 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Shared Grace
features.description: When Siphon Grace heals you, an ally within 30 feet also regains HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1).

features.name: Temperance
features.description: Advantage on rolls against charm and possession. Once per short rest as a reaction, grant that advantage to an ally within 30 feet for one roll.

features.name: Fortitude
features.description: When you finish a short rest, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your Wraith level.

features.name: Charity
features.description: Action: transfer any number of your temporary HP to allies within 30 feet, or spend a short-rest slot to heal all allies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Intellect. Once per short rest for the slot heal.

features.name: Perfect Virtue
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Virtue's Mend does not expend uses, Shared Grace heals twice Intellect, and allies within 30 feet have resistance to necrotic and psychic.
